sections.title: If you already have the 20 unnoted balls of wool

steps.text: Talk to Fred the Farmer north of Lumbridge.
Fred takes the 20 balls of wool.

sections.title: If you don't have the balls of wool
notes: ::Note: You cannot shear Rams or "The Thing". If you attack a ram and cannot kill it, run out of the pen until it stops targeting you.

steps.text: Talk to Fred the Farmer north of Lumbridge.
He will give you shears if you do not have them.
Enter the sheep pen to the east, connected to his house and shear sheep for 20 wool.
Ultimate Ironmen: You can deliver the balls of wool in several trips. You do not have to deliver all 20 at once.
Go to the of Lumbridge Castle.
Click on the spinning wheel in the southern room to spin the wool.
With 20 un-noted balls of wool, return to Fred the Farmer.
Talk to Fred the Farmer and hand them in.
chat: 1. I need to talk to you about shearing these sheep!
